purpose: Teach: カバー/臭い/クマ/思いっきり/水分/どっか/品物/大根

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんの、本気で、絶対、お店、絶対、椅子の、絶対、カバー、絶対、変えたわ
lines.en: Sho, I actually changed the chair covers at my shop today!
lines.style: Bright, animated energy. Quick opening, like she's excited to share news. Warm and proud of the small thing she did. Voice sits forward in the mouth.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼくの、本気で、絶対、お弁当箱、絶対、臭い、絶対、なっちゃったかも
lines.en: Mei-sis, I think my bento box might have gotten a little smelly…
lines.style: Quiet, embarrassed admission. Hesitant delivery, like he's confessing something he didn't mean to say out loud. Eyes down. Soft, trailing off at the end.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、クマ、絶対、目の下、絶対、できちゃったわ
lines.en: Sho, I've got dark circles under my eyes now — real talk.
lines.style: Dry, wry tone. Understated complaint wrapped in humor. Matter-of-fact delivery like she's not asking for sympathy, just stating facts. Light self-deprecation.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、運動会で、本気で、絶対、思いっきり、絶対、走ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I ran my hardest at sports day today!
lines.style: Earnest pride in his voice. Bright and genuine without being loud. Opens with confidence, looking up to share his win. Small glow of accomplishment underneath.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、本気で、絶対、水分、絶対、忘れずに、絶対、取ってね
lines.en: Sho, make sure you drink plenty of water, okay?
lines.style: Caring, practical instruction. Warm but direct — the tone of someone who notices and looks after. Not fussy, just steady and attentive.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、本気で、絶対、どっか、絶対、お出かけしたいな
lines.en: Mei-sis, I want to go somewhere with you sometime!
lines.style: Hopeful, eager pitch. Slight question mark at the end even though it's a statement. Genuine longing, a kid asking for something he really wants. Open and unguarded.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、お洒落な、絶対、品物、絶対、お店に、絶対、入れたわ
lines.en: Sho, I actually brought some nice things into the shop today!
lines.style: Pleased, animated again. Similar energy to the first line but with a slightly different focus — she's proud of her eye for nice things. Quick, bright, forward momentum.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ママが、本気で、絶対、大根、絶対、お味噌汁、絶対、作ってくれたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Mom made daikon miso soup for us!
lines.style: Warm, delighted sharing. Like he's telling her something small and good that he wants her to know. Gentle brightness, the contentment of a small comfort. Unpressured and genuine.
